plugins.name: redis-core
plugins.description: Core Redis modeling — data structures, key naming, memory and TTL, atomic primitives, JSON vs Hash, Streams vs Pub/Sub.

plugins.name: redis-connections
plugins.description: Redis client and connection guidance — pooling, multiplexing, pipelining, client-side caching, timeouts, slow commands.

plugins.name: redis-query-engine
plugins.description: Redis Query Engine (RQE) — FT.CREATE schema, FT.SEARCH / FT.AGGREGATE, DIALECT 2, field types, zero-downtime updates.

plugins.name: redis-vector-search
plugins.description: Redis vector search — HNSW vs FLAT, vector index configuration, hybrid search, the RAG retrieval pattern with RedisVL.

plugins.name: redis-semantic-cache
plugins.description: Redis LangCache — cache-aside flow for LLM responses, similarity threshold tuning, per-task cache separation.

plugins.name: redis-clustering
plugins.description: Redis Cluster and replication — hash tags for multi-key operations, avoiding CROSSSLOT, reading from replicas.

plugins.name: redis-security
plugins.description: Redis security hardening — authentication and TLS, ACL-based least privilege, network bind, firewall, command renaming.

plugins.name: redis-observability
plugins.description: Redis observability — key metrics to monitor (INFO), debugging commands (SLOWLOG, MEMORY DOCTOR, FT.PROFILE), Redis Insight.
